title: Pretty close
body: Pretty simple and to the point. Which is what I wanted. That and widgets. The time is only in 24 hour increments and I don’t see any option to switch it to 12. I’d rather know I have something to do at 5:30 rather than 17:30. That’s my biggest issue so far. And having the length of times easier to set and change would be helpful. Lastly, when selection an icon (emoji) there is no option to collapse the keyboard. All easy fixes and hopefully the time change is the first one and comes soon. Only had it for about 5 mins so I’ll edit if there’s anything else to add. Other than those things it’s pretty much exactly what I was looking for.

body:

title: Not there yet
body: First of all this app is a complete ripoff of the Structured app in every way. I’m not sure why the developer felt this app was ready to be published. This app is filled with all types of bugs and UI issues. I removed all my tasks from every day and it was still sending me reminders and pings. Who knows what other background processes this thing is running on my phone, no thanks. It’s not all bad but the stuff that is bad makes this unusable. I’ll check back in a few weeks to see if there have been any updates, until then — delete.
author: Syrius G

title: Lots of bugs!!!
body: I was planning on using this app as a way to stay on top of my daily task like my classes, gym time, ect but this app has too many bugs. There is no tutorial on how to use the features in this app. When I use the routine feature, the days don’t set to the ones I selected and are difficult to understand. The alert feature has not worked even tho I allowed the app access. The app freezes (on&off) when I edit a routine I’ve added. The statistics feature also doesn’t reset (or regress) if you unselect a completed task, which basically renders it useless (imo). Overall, I won’t be using this app moving forward. It has some great features so I hope this app can be improved to a better quality of use.
